data.long_meaning: The name Francene is of unknown origin, but it is thought to derive from the French words franc (free) and cœur (heart), meaning 'free, frank, and honest'. This name was popular in medieval Europe and was borne by several saints and royal women. The name Francene carries the meaning “Free, frank, and honest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Francene usually hope their child will grow to embody free, frank, and honest and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Francene
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Francene originem habet gallicam et significat 'liberam' vel 'mundam'. In traditione christiana, nomen Francene reflectit valores libertatis et puritatis. Nomen hoc est compositum ex gallico 'franc', quod significat 'liber', et suffixo '-ene', quod significat 'mundus' vel 'purus'.
